description: Returns the coverage and currency of the data: trust and loan counts, as-of and filing dates, the headline index, the limits with and without a key, licence and links to the docs, OpenAPI and changelog. Use it to answer how current or complete the data is, or what limits apply.
name: about

outputSchema.description: Every field with its unit and codes, in full: https://cmbs.news/openapi.json (operation meta). Money in US dollars; a rate, occupancy or share is a fraction of 1 (0.0475 is 4.75%) unless it says percent; DSCR is a multiple; dates YYYY-MM-DD.

argumentNote.description: Sent when an argument was renamed, read in another form or left out because it could not be used: says which and how.

asOf.description: End date of the latest reporting period in the loan data, YYYY-MM-DD.

balance.description: Sum of those loans' current balances, whole dollars.

callsLeft.description: Without a key: calls left today on the free allowance, this one counted. Not sent with a Pro or Team key.

filedFrom.description: Earliest filing date among the trusts' latest filings read, YYYY-MM-DD.

filedTo.description: Latest filing date among them, YYYY-MM-DD.

freshness.description: When each part of the data was last checked or updated by the daily job.

checked.description: When the daily job last looked for new filings, ISO 8601 date-time in UTC.

comments.description: Count of loans with a special servicer's comment on file now.

historyMonths.description: The (up to) 12 most recent months, YYYY-MM, that the loans' monthly history covers.

index.description: The distress index's latest month: the same object as headline in the index answer (documented in openapi.json.ts).

avgAge.description: Balance-weighted average loan age in months since origination.

balance.description: Sum of balances of the loan records filed for the month, in dollars.

dlqRate.description: Share of that balance 30+ days delinquent or matured unpaid (payment status 1, 2, 3 or 5), a fraction of 1.

loans.description: Count of loan records filed for the month (records, not loans; defeased included).

maturedRate.description: Share of balance that is a non-performing matured balloon (status 5; part of dlqRate), a fraction of 1.

ssRate.description: Share of balance with the special servicer, a fraction of 1.

trusts.description: Count of trusts that filed loan-level data for the month.

keyNote.description: Sent when the key given was a placeholder (such as YOUR_KEY): the call was answered as a call without a key, and this says why.

loans.description: Count of loans still outstanding: the count behind every list and total on the site.

loansLeftOut.description: Loans the site has pages for that are not in loans and balance.

carried.description: Count of loans a trust's latest asset file omits while its 10-D still reports them (pages kept, no current status).

defeased.description: Count of fully defeased loans (backed by Treasuries) left out.

loansNote.description: Fixed text explaining what loans, balance and index.loans each count.

limits.description: Address of the limits and plans page.

refreshed.description: Day the loan data was last refreshed, YYYY-MM-DD.

servicerComments.description: Count of loans with a special servicer's comment on file, as of the monthly build.

source.description: Fixed text naming the SEC forms the data comes from.

tenants.description: Count of tenants with a tenant page (named among the three largest on 3 or more loans).

trusts.description: Count of trusts whose loans are on the site.

wireMonth.description: Month of the current issue of The Wire, YYYY-MM.

title: About the data
